shared_setup: Obtain resource permit and current build receipt per stabilization PLAN: source SHA and dirty-source hash if applicable, lockfile/output hashes, WXT mode, loaded extension ID, Chrome version, role/profile, auth and selected org, required permissions, backend identity, timestamp; redact credentials and unrelated records. Reload the receipt-bound unpacked extension and reopen signed-in side panel before post-reload pass; a changed artifact needs a new receipt.

Run independently in existing signed-in member and admin profiles with distinct owned fixtures and current selected organization. Do not create/change roles, accounts, organizations, or permissions. Guest Tools UI access is a separate negative-access case; do not call it passed or N/A for dispatcher/auth behavior.

Tools > Catalog > Agent surface: search exact handler, expand row, enter JSON, Run, inspect inline result. This runner validates schema then calls handler.run directly with conversationId=null, assignedTabId=null, permissionMode=act. It bypasses dispatcher authorization; action/Ask gating, advertised agent call and guest denial remain unverified here.

Keep only exact owned fixture IDs and sanitized result excerpts. Never copy unrelated guidance/highlight text, private rows, tokens, storage dumps or raw logs into evidence. Stop if a supposedly synthetic ID collides with existing data. Clean only exact returned owned IDs; track any unresolved cloud cleanup by ID.

preconditions: Use shared setup. Storage permission must be present in receipt-bound artifact. Pick unique procedure-guidance.invalid domain, role-specific caption, harmless text, and optional origin_url under an owned test URL; no real page/person data.

Guidance save writes chrome.storage.local item and list index, then launches best-effort cloud push. A local success or reload is not cloud proof. Confirm active organization on device before cloud assertion.
steps: In each role run save_guidance_note with {"domain":"procedure-guidance.invalid","text":"owned synthetic guidance note <role> <nonce>","caption":"EXT-F-4137-T01 <role> <nonce>"}; retain returned UUID exactly. Get that UUID through get_guidance_item and verify kind=note and exact fields, then list_guidance with domain and verify matching summary. Record only sanitized fixture output.
For bad input run {} and then {"domain":"","text":""}; require runner Schema mismatch, no handler result, no new fixture. Also use malformed JSON to require Invalid JSON and no invocation.

Reload receipt-bound extension and side panel; get exact UUID and list filtered domain again. For cloud persistence claim, obtain authorized exact-ID scoped extend.wbx_guidance read showing live row and matching fields or independent same-principal hydration in another profile; same-profile reload proves local cache only.

Delete only exact returned UUID through delete_guidance_item, confirm get returns missing locally after reload. For confirmed cloud row require exact-ID deleted_at tombstone and independent same-principal hydrated absence; if save never reached cloud, exact-ID absence confirms cleanup only. If cloud observation unavailable, leave cloud persistence/deletion unverified and track cleanup open by ID.
expected: Positive save returns {ok:true,id:<UUID>,domain:<chosen domain>}; exact local note and list summary survive reload.
Invalid inputs are rejected by runner before handler; no new local/cloud item.
Cloud claim requires independent exact-ID evidence; failed best-effort push, stale local cache, or late resurrection cannot count as full pass.

preconditions: Use shared setup; storage permission in receipt. Create one owned note through save_guidance_note in each profile and retain exact returned UUID; distinguish role fixtures. Do not assume pre-existing guidance inventory is empty or read unrelated details.
steps: Run list_guidance with {"domain":"procedure-guidance.invalid"}; find exact owned UUID and assert summary kind=note, domain, caption and count=items.length. Run with {"domain":"sub.procedure-guidance.invalid"} to verify parent-domain inclusion. Run with a unique nonmatching .invalid domain and require owned UUID absent; do not assert global count zero.

Run {} and blank runner input (default {}) as valid unfiltered read; check exact owned UUID is present and count=items.length, without recording unrelated summaries. If a broad read would expose private unrelated rows, inspect only the owned ID in UI and redact all other content from evidence.

Run {"domain":123} and malformed JSON; require Schema mismatch and Invalid JSON respectively, no handler result. The schema permits empty string; treat {"domain":""} as unfiltered behavior from args.domain falsiness, not an invalid-input case.

Reload extension and side panel and repeat filtered and nonmatching reads for owned UUID. Delete exact owned UUID, verify it is absent from filtered list before and after reload; use exact-ID cloud observation/tombstone rules from save case for any sync or cleanup claim.
expected: Filtered, parent-subdomain and unfiltered outputs are {ok:true,count:<items.length>,items:[summaries]}; owned summary inclusion/exclusion follows domain comparison before and after reload.
Invalid numeric domain/malformed JSON are blocked by runner. List outputs are local index only; cloud parity remains separately unverified without exact-ID observation.
Cleanup deletes only returned owned UUID and records unresolved exact-ID cloud state.

preconditions: Use shared setup with signed-in Supabase session and selected active organization for capture write. Inventory declares no Chrome permission for this handler; do not invent a host/optional-permission requirement. Use an owned .invalid or otherwise controlled page reachable by the test profile; record exact URL and a distinct same-domain second URL. Create a harmless text passage highlight with Highlight tab and capture its returned/saved UUID from the UI/authorized exact-ID read; do not use unrelated highlights. If fixture cannot be saved, stop positive branch.
steps: On controlled page create one text highlight in Highlight tab. Confirm saved row exists via authorized exact-ID read of extend.wbx_highlight or owned UI row; note exact id, mode, text, URL and anchor. In Tools Agent surface run list_highlights with {"scope":"page","url":"<exact fixture URL>","limit":100}; assert exact owned ID appears with projected mode/text/url/reference and count=highlights.length. An explicit URL avoids the manual runner's assignedTabId=null active-tab ambiguity.

Run site scope with exact fixture URL and verify owned ID appears; run page scope with same-domain second URL and verify it does not; run all scope with limit 1000 and verify owned ID only if within result window. Assert all-scope url is null and page/site url is explicit URL. Do not infer site scope includes subdomains: query uses exact stored domain.

Run {"scope":"other"}, {"limit":0}, {"limit":1001}, {"url":123}, and malformed JSON; require schema/JSON rejection with no handler result. The URL schema accepts arbitrary strings; do not claim malformed URL is rejected. Run page scope without URL only after focusing controlled tab; document resolved tab URL or null and compare output accordingly. No assigned tab is bound by this runner.

Reload controlled page and receipt-bound extension/side panel; repeat explicit page/site calls and verify exact owned ID. Delete only owned highlight through Highlight tab; require UI deletion confirmed and exact-ID deleted_at tombstone, then repeat explicit page/site/all calls after reload and require owned ID absent. If deletion fails or cannot be verified, record exact-ID cleanup open.
expected: Read result has {ok:true,scope,url,count,highlights}; each item projects id,mode,text,url,reference(selector/ref/role/tag/text_quote),created_at. Exact owned highlight appears in matching page/site scope and disappears after confirmed soft delete/reload.

Invalid enum/type/limit and malformed JSON are rejected by runner. An empty list alone cannot prove no data or permission success because query errors return [] and parse failures skip rows; verify source row and watch sanitized error channel for read failures.
RLS/auth scope and organization isolation require separate server policy/dispatcher tests; this manual read verifies only observed signed-in handler result.

unresolved_dimensions: No browser/build/DB execution in this source-only lane: all role cells and actual permission outcomes remain unverified.
Manual runner bypasses dispatcher; Ask/Act gate, agent advertisement, guest denial, and role-based auth/organization isolation need separate cases.
Guidance cloud push/delete are asynchronous; exact-ID scoped cloud or independently hydrated same-principal observation is needed for sync/durable cleanup claims.
Highlights reads return [] on database error and silently skip invalid rows; empty/missing data cannot certify access denial or successful read without independent fixture row and error observation.
Inventory/catalog metadata was previously captured and does not establish current live binding at runtime; receipt-bound registry reconciliation remains open.
